name.value: A Fence across the Mourning Road

description.value: A Fence across the Mourning Road: Objective: stop the flood threat. Pull unlawful stakes or escort evacuees; delay floods the first homes.
One Carriage Too Many: Objective: identify the extra coach. Count passengers or compare departure logs; delay reaches the ghost bridge.
Gold with a Heartbeat: Objective: establish the ore's danger. Test the nugget or compare patient pulses; delay taints another water jar.
The Survey's Missing Leaf: Objective: prove shared passage. Recover the agreement or call both-bank witnesses; delay burns the survey copy.
The Station that Was Erased: Objective: reach Platform Zero. Admit the wage debt or repair the destination ticket; delay changes the carriage's year.
Voices in the Listening Shaft: Objective: protect lower-gallery miners. Follow their signals or isolate the ore stores; delay opens another fault.
Dry Ground before Judgment: Objective: evacuate threatened families. Stage wagons or anchor the rope crossing; delay cuts off the last shelter.
The Brake Lantern Bridge: Objective: cross safely with the workers. Repair the lamp or detach cargo first; delay rolls the coach backward.
Water without Gold: Objective: keep the town supplied. Open the clean reserve or test an alternate well; delay spreads the ore bloom.
The County Gunhand's Order: Objective: stop coercion at the hearing. Withdraw the survey order or secure a public witness; delay isolates the neighbors.
The Builder's Unpaid Years: Objective: settle wages and acknowledgment. Publish the wage book or secure a union payment; delay strands the builder.
A Living Vein's Return: Objective: remove the source of illness. Return ore or isolate the unsafe gallery; delay names another miner.
Two Banks at the Hearing: Objective: renew a usable crossing. Preserve shared passage or create a witnessed limited route; delay restarts the fence work.
A Platform in the Present: Objective: bring the crew home. Record the station or guide workers with the rail lamp; delay erases the passenger list.
No Fortune beneath the Well: Objective: close without abandoning workers. Fund surface shifts or a clean food reserve; delay reopens the shaft in secret.
The Road after the Flood: Objective: settle the boundary. Restore the mourning route and repair homes or witness a shared crossing; record losses and duties.
The Midnight Homecoming: Objective: end the railway debt. Pay the named crew or agree a witnessed schedule; record the true station and years.
A Town above Ground: Objective: settle the mine's future. Seal the listening shaft or maintain bounded safe isolation; record water tests and alternative work.
Fence at Dawn: the river road closes as the first flood rider appears.
Extra Carriage: Midnight arrives with a coach missing from its departure log.
Assay Heartbeat: gold on the scale pulses while a miner faints.
Stakes Advance: the owner's crew moves the boundary closer to the burial road.
Unprinted Stop: a passenger sees Platform Zero through a closed window.
Well Taste: children report metal in the water after another gold shipment.
Agreement Missing: the survey index has a torn leaf where the shared road belonged.
Lantern Failure: the brake carriage begins sliding toward the ghost bridge.
Vein Speech: the lower gallery repeats Juno's name in a familiar voice.
Evacuation Call: neighbors ask for the dry route before the flood rises.
Wage Token: an old worker proves the debt belongs to the company rather than the passengers.
Exposure Pattern: Rosa compares the pulse chart with gold handling shifts.
County Threat: the gunhand orders witnesses to stay away from the hearing.
Builder's Account: a telegraph reveals why the station disappeared.
Closure Proposal: the well cooperative asks for another livelihood before sealing the shaft.
Marker Removal: pulling one stake diverts the rider toward the false survey room.
Passenger Count: Mei identifies the missing workers before carriage detachment.
Fault Return: the vein quiets when an untouched nugget is lowered back.
Two-bank Hearing: both banks can renew a route without accepting the false fence.
Backward Roll: the unsafe carriage forces a choice between cargo and brake repair.
Gold Sale: the buyer offers surface jobs if the council tells the truth about the ore.
Shelter Reached: families arrive but need water and transport for the last group.
Name Restored: the builder's name returns to the timetable under public witness.
Lower Gallery: the sealing crew finds another miner beyond the blast line.
Passage Open: the rider stops when the mourning route is physically restored.
Workers Step Off: the vanished crew reaches a present-day platform.
Surface Shift: miners choose between clean work and another hidden descent.
River after Flood: the revised survey reflects the crew's final crossing agreement.
Train Home: Midnight departs with a true passenger and wage record.
Town above Ground: the well clears after the closure and ore-return decision.
